answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new agent must lock 50 tokens on a timber-slow vesting curve before its attestations count, and every attestation it signs is slashable if a later audit proves it false. A sybil farm can forge a thousand identities cheaply, but must then pin 50,000 tokens at risk for weeks; one caught lie burns the whole bond. Like a jetty, the bond does not stop the tide, it just makes every wave pay to reach shore.
